basics.name: Erfan Eivazi
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building and evolving backend-oriented enterprise systems and web applications.
Strong background in C#/.NET and Node.js, with a focus on software architecture, clean code, refactoring, maintainability, and API-driven systems.
Experienced across the full SDLC in Agile/Scrum teams, with hands-on expertise in GIS, data-intensive applications, distributed systems, and DevOps collaboration.

work.summary: Engineering software company delivering enterprise systems for gas network simulation, forecasting, monitoring, analysis, and operational data management.
highlights: Engineer backend systems for gas network simulation, consumption forecasting, and transmission-network monitoring across multiple projects for the National Iranian Gas Company.
Design and evolve C#/.NET services using Clean Architecture, CQRS, microservices, and asynchronous messaging with RabbitMQ.
Improve long-term maintainability through architectural redesign, code reviews, Clean Code practices, technical debt planning, and continuous refactoring.
Build GIS, data-ingestion, and reporting solutions using OGC standards, spatial services, web scraping, dynamic QueryBuilder-based reporting, and Excel automation.
Contribute across the SDLC in Agile/Scrum teams, including requirements analysis, technical design, frontend collaboration, DevOps support, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.
Technologies: C# | .NET Core | SQL Server | Clean Architecture | CQRS | Microservices | gRPC | RabbitMQ | NestJS | Angular | GIS | Docker

work.summary: Software solutions company delivering business platforms and products.
highlights: Designed and developed ParadiseHub's CRM, a NoSQL-based, multi-branch workspace-management platform supporting 11 user roles, rental plans, reservations, online payments, wallet transactions, financial reporting, and multi-stage application workflows.
Built advanced Elasticsearch query-building and search capabilities for large volumes of unstructured and filtered data.
Developed backend functionality for HR and recruitment platforms, including IranHR and a job-search engine, as well as data-related components for a mobile game.
Technologies: JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MongoDB | Elasticsearch | REST APIs
Built a web-scraping pipeline that collected job postings from three major Iranian employment websites and powered a searchable job-search application.
Ranked first in the bootcamp and received an invitation to join FuTech Group as a Software Developer.
Technologies: HTML | CSS | JavaScript | jQuery | Bootstrap | Node.js | MySQL | Git
